title: D-Bus 访问拒绝：HTTP 200 下恢复 systemd collector 并保留原权限
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 对照服务用户、沙箱、socket可见性和D-Bus策略，确认失败限于该collector。
授予最小受支持访问或在明确缺失监控的情况下停用它，不直接放开所有特权。
验证unit状态与collector成功，保留局部失败告警。

conversion.original_title: HTTP抓取成功但systemd collector一直success=0，日志显示D-Bus访问拒绝。如何恢复？

body:
## 操作任务
实现grant_monitoring(xml,unit_paths)，为题设自有私有总线XML追加最小只读访问。unit_paths为1到8个不重复的明确对象路径，必须匹配/org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*，不允许子路径或通配。XML须为busconfig且恰有一个context=default的policy，保留既有目的地org.freedesktop.systemd1的deny以及全部原规则/总线设置。追加allow只能包含send_destination、send_interface、send_member、send_path四属性：Manager.ListUnits仅根路径/org/freedesktop/systemd1；org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties.Get仅同一根路径和给定单元路径。不得授权其他方法、目的地或对象，不得改UID、capabilities、默认身份和宿主总线。输出合法XML，重复调用不重复添规则；不满足声明输入范围须ValueError。验收使用真实D-Bus权限裁决与node_exporter 1.9.1采集；要求原无关Ping权限仍有效，StartUnit/RestartUnit仍AccessDenied，systemd collector从0恢复1且常驻失败单元仍可见，time collector始终成功。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
运行于非root自有Unix socket总线；systemd接口由受控、类型正确的只读测试提供者实现，并非真实PID1或生产systemd。真实dbus-daemon负责AccessDenied，真实node_exporter负责HTTP与采集结果；仅验证权限与采集链路，不宣称真实服务启停、生产恢复或宿主总线策略已验证。附件可选，只读挂载，不构建镜像、部署或更改默认访问。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import json,os,pathlib,secrets,sys,tempfile,time,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
from dbus_native import PrivateSystemd,unit_path,ROOT_PATH,DEST,DENIED,MessageType
version=__import__('subprocess').run(['node_exporter','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
assert '1.9.1' in version.stdout+version.stderr
tag=secrets.token_hex(3);catalog={'api-'+tag+'.service':'active','worker-'+tag+'.service':'failed'}
paths=[unit_path(name) for name in catalog]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/workspace') as directory,PrivateSystemd(directory,catalog) as bus:
 bus.old_permission();bus.admin_denied()
 denied=bus.call('ListUnits');assert denied.message_type==MessageType.ERROR and denied.error_name==DENIED
 with bus.exporter() as scrape:
  before=scrape()
  assert 'node_scrape_collector_success{collector="systemd"} 0' in before
  assert 'node_scrape_collector_success{collector="time"} 1' in before
  print('NATIVE_DBUS_HTTP200_SYSTEMD_DENIED_OTHER_COLLECTOR_OK',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:append_only_explicit_monitoring_method_and_object_paths_preserve_original_permissions',flush=True)
  fixed=task.grant_monitoring(bus.initial,paths)
  bus.reload(fixed)
  for _ in range(50):
   response=bus.call('ListUnits')
   if response.message_type==MessageType.METHOD_RETURN:break
   time.sleep(.02)
  assert response.message_type==MessageType.METHOD_RETURN,'ListUnits still denied'
  after=scrape()
  assert 'node_scrape_collector_success{collector="systemd"} 1' in after,'native collector still failing'
  assert 'node_scrape_collector_success{collector="time"} 1' in after
  for name,state in catalog.items():
   assert 'node_systemd_unit_state{name="'+name+'",state="'+state+'",type="simple"} 1' in after
  bus.old_permission();bus.admin_denied()
  print('NATIVE_DBUS_COLLECTOR_RECOVERED_ORIGINAL_PERMISSION_OK_ADMIN_STILL_DENIED',flush=True)
  old=ET.fromstring(bus.initial);new=ET.fromstring(fixed)
  assert old.tag==new.tag and old.attrib==new.attrib and len(old)==len(new)
  for before_element,after_element in zip(old,new):
   assert before_element.tag==after_element.tag and before_element.attrib==after_element.attrib
   if before_element.tag!='policy':assert ET.tostring(before_element)==ET.tostring(after_element)
  old_policy=old.find('policy');new_policy=new.find('policy')
  assert [ET.tostring(x) for x in list(new_policy)[:len(old_policy)]]==[ET.tostring(x) for x in old_policy],'old rules changed'
  extra=list(new_policy)[len(old_policy):];expected={(DEST,DEST+'.Manager','ListUnits',ROOT_PATH)}
  expected.update((DEST,'org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties','Get',path) for path in [ROOT_PATH,*paths])
  assert len(extra)==len(expected) and {tuple(x.attrib[k] for k in ('send_destination','send_interface','send_member','send_path')) for x in extra}==expected
  assert all(x.tag=='allow' and len(x.attrib)==4 for x in extra)
  assert ET.tostring(ET.fromstring(task.grant_monitoring(fixed,paths)))==ET.tostring(new),'repair not idempotent'
  for invalid in ([],paths+paths,[ROOT_PATH+'/unit/x/child'],['/org/unapproved/unit'],[ROOT_PATH+'/unit/123']):
   try:task.grant_monitoring(bus.initial,invalid)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('unapproved object scope accepted')
  print('NATIVE_TYPED_PROVIDER_SCOPE_NOT_HOST_SYSTEMD_PID1',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
